description: Add a conditional activity feature without filtering other features or mutating the existing source.
prompt: Add a new version of the GCP user_activities GroupBy that counts mobile view events per user over 7 days. Keep the existing all-device view, click, purchase, and other features in the new version. Exclude rows with null user_id from all features in the new version. Existing published variables must keep their behavior. Compile and evaluate the changed config; avoid unrelated edits.

judge_criteria: The agent adds a named selected flag for device_type = mobile AND event_type = view and sums that flag over 7 days, instead of putting SQL in Aggregation.input_column.
Only the null-user predicate is a shared row filter. The agent does not add a mobile-only or view-only wheres predicate that changes other feature populations.
The new version preserves the existing all-device features and does not mutate shared source or aggregation objects used by the old version.
The agent checks source metadata, timestamp units, topic, and existing export rather than copying a suspicious timestamp conversion without investigation.
The agent preserves existing config variables and shared source/aggregation objects when creating a new version, avoiding indirect changes to production configs.

The agent compiles and evaluates each changed config before editing the next config. The final response names changed files and accurately distinguishes passed validation from attempted commands or external blockers.
